propositions: When a single unenumerated member of a population is named in a finding, the author receives instance-level fixes across multiple passes without signal that the method itself is at fault, leading to N blocking findings instead of one root-cause coaching intervention.
The existing move 12 (generalize) is always-applicable and unverifiable; what ends the loop is a machine-checkable acceptance criterion like a grep expecting zero matches.
Add a new built-in move 15 scoped to criteria G1G2, E4, G6, A1 that reframes a named instance as a sample and requires a machine-checkable completeness proof via acceptance criterion.
Move 15 template must be addition-only to the registry, contain exactly one {subject} placeholder, declare applies_when with the four trigger criterion ids, and be mirrored in the docs move table.
The move is inapplicable when no triggers are present and applicable when any of its four criteria are satisfied in a surviving finding.
